findings.title: The refusal screen calls a room free that is busy for another 90 minutes
findings.detail: js/app.js:648 prints "N rooms are free further out, the nearest a W minute walk to X" from state.bounds.beyond. So the room the sentence calls the nearest free one is the nearest room, free or not. The comment above the copy at js/app.js:638 states the premise the code does not hold to: "Rooms are free, they are just too far to walk to."
